ov: The Eurasian magpie is a black-and-white member of the crow family found across northern Europe and Asia, and one of the most intelligent birds. It’s one of the few birds known to pass the mirror test. More than half its length is tail.
rg: The northern part of Europe and Asia.
df: Almost anything: young birds and eggs, small mammals, insects, scraps, carrion, acorns and grain.
fx: Relative to its size, part of its brain is about as big as the equivalent area in chimpanzees and humans.
The oldest magpie on record, ringed near Coventry, lived 21 years and 8 months.
